utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still lining up the stuff we need, and I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors too. Hopefully we can get enough help together.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Rey — I’ll go through the list and tell you what’s still missing. If anything else comes up for the gate, I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive’s this Saturday at 9, isn’t it? If you’re sending reminders, I can help if you need me to, though I might need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Saturday at 9 at the community lot—I'll send a reminder with the details. Thanks, Noah; if you can help round people up, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great, Jules — mostly we just need folks with tools or quick fixes, even an extra pair of hands would help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll tell people to bring tools, help with quick fixes, or just lend a hand if they can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out on errands later, so I’ll ask around and see if they still need any tools or spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that’d help. Let me know if they’ve started taking donations yet or if they’re still just gathering tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around while I’m out and see whether they’re taking donations yet or still just collecting tools. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’d just want the final list and timing, and then I can see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still checking on the final details, but it sounds like old tools and broken lamps are being dropped off by the community hall. If I hear anything new, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know as soon as you hear. For now, let’s start with the biggest broken thing first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know right away. Starting with the biggest broken thing sounds like a good plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that helps a lot. I should mention the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so let’s plan for that instead.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sunday at the community center works for me — I’ll bring the tools and still ask around for a couple more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Mara — that’ll be a big help. I’ll have everything ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9 on Saturday still works for me—I’ll help however I can and keep it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, 9 on Saturday works for me too. I’m still a little out of the loop, but I can help sort donations or bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be wonderful, Nell — thanks for jumping in. I can help sort things and keep the timing clear around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — just a quick update, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. If you’ve got anything to drop off, I can help make sure it gets where it needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — before I commit, I’d still want to confirm the full list and exactly where things are being dropped off. Then I can see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I can send you the full list, and everything’s going to the community center on Sunday. Once you’ve looked it over, just let me know what you can take on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did you get confirmation on the repair drive details yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m heading out on errands later and I’ll check around for any last details. I’ll also see if they still need tools, spare parts, or volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please let me know as soon as you get confirmation on the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can check in quietly and see if they need anything specific. If it helps, I can also point a few folks toward the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Uli — I’ll keep spreading the word too, and we can send folks to the sign-in table if they need help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll stop by later and ask what they still need, then send anyone I see over to the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that—what time should people come by, and where should they drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great—thanks, Sam. I’ll let people know the time and drop-off spot as soon as we’ve got it set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—just send me the time and drop-off spot when you’ve got them set, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll send it over as soon as I finish the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — I’ll drop everything off at your porch on Maple Street and label any fragile items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Is the repair drive already collecting donations, or are you still setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s already collecting donations—I’m just organizing the drop-off on Maple Street and labeling the fragile stuff.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can swing by and help sort donations or carry a few things; just point me in the right direction and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I think they still need help sorting donations and carrying supplies at the community lot at 9.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll head to the community lot at 9 and help sort donations and carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like folks are already pitching in nicely. I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver and see if the gate repair still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Gus — if you can, please spread the word that we’re still collecting donations and volunteers this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and remind folks we’re still collecting donations and volunteers this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks for the reminder — I can help spread the word. Just let me know if you still need volunteers or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I do still need a few volunteers and maybe some basic supplies. I’ll keep you posted on the final list for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — just send me the final list on Saturday morning, and I’ll help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need the full plan for the repair drive—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve been spreading the word, and we’re meeting at the community center parking lot sign-in table. Just tell me the time, and I’ll help get a few more neighbors there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — let’s keep it simple and set a clear time. What time should we meet at the community center parking lot sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Could you bring a screwdriver, some tape, and maybe a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — let’s get the gate handled first. I’ll keep an eye on the leak and the steps light after that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo. Just to check, are you saying the gate comes first, and then you’ll handle the leak and the steps light after?
